name: 53583 · Sauk City, WI
findings: ZIP 53583 (Sauk City) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53583 (Sauk City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53583 (Sauk City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
